project.name: strongSwan SW
project.description: Enterprise-grade strongSwan VPN packages with PostgreSQL database support. Production-ready builds for modern Linux distributions.
project.trademarkNotice: strongSwan is a registered trademark of Andreas Steffen and the strongSwan project. This is an independent distribution not affiliated with or endorsed by the strongSwan project.
project.sourceNotice: Complete source code is available at github.com/structured-world/strongswan.

packages.name: strongswan-sw
packages.summary: Complete strongSwan VPN distribution with all standard plugins. This is the base package required for IKEv2/IPsec VPN server functionality.

packages.name: strongswan-pgsql
packages.summary: PostgreSQL database backend for strongSwan. Enables sql and attr-sql plugins to store credentials, IP pools, and connection attributes.

packages.name: strongswan-dhcp-inform
packages.summary: Responds to Windows DHCP INFORM requests with split-tunnel routes from PostgreSQL. Delivers classless static routes via DHCP option 121/249.

deb.repoSetup:
# Add GPG key
curl -fsSL https://repo.sw.foundation/keys/sw.gpg \
  | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/sw.gpg

# Add repository
echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/sw.gpg] \
  https://repo.sw.foundation/deb $(lsb_release -cs) main" \
  | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/sw.list

sudo apt update
